title: Linux: Service stopped
evidence: systemctl: failed; journal: EnvironmentFile /etc/orders.env not found; port 8080 closed
cause: A required environment file was removed during deployment.
checks: systemctl status orders; journalctl -u orders -n 50; systemctl cat orders
fix: Restore the approved environment file with restricted permissions, then restart the service.
verify: Service active; local health endpoint and external request succeed.
prevent: Validate required files before deployment.

title: Linux: High CPU
evidence: load average 8.2 on 2 CPUs; one worker uses 198% CPU; requests repeat the same calculation
cause: A new worker release introduced a CPU-heavy loop.
checks: top -H; ps -eo pid,pcpu,comm --sort=-pcpu; compare release timestamps
fix: Capture profiling evidence, then roll back the faulty worker or stop its retry loop.
verify: CPU and latency return to baseline under representative traffic.
prevent: Profile expensive paths and bound retries.

title: Linux: Out of memory
evidence: journal: Out of memory: Killed process worker; worker RSS grows with queue depth
cause: An unbounded work queue exhausts host memory.
checks: free -m; journalctl -k; ps -eo pid,rss,comm --sort=-rss
fix: Reduce concurrency, bound the queue, and restart or roll back the leaking worker.
verify: Memory stabilizes and queued work continues without kernel kills.
prevent: Load-test memory behavior and alert on sustained growth.

title: Linux: Disk full
evidence: df: /var 100%; du: application.log 18G; logrotate timer failed
cause: Application logs grew without rotation.
checks: df -h; du -xhd1 /var; systemctl status logrotate.timer
fix: Preserve required incident evidence; rotate the specific log and restore rotation.
verify: Space remains available while new logs are written.
prevent: Test rotation and alert before exhaustion.

title: Linux: File permissions
evidence: worker runs as app; /srv/orders/cache owned root:root mode 0700; Permission denied
cause: A deployment changed ownership of the writable directory.
checks: id app; namei -l /srv/orders/cache; stat /srv/orders/cache
fix: Restore ownership for the application directory and grant only required access.
verify: A write succeeds as the application user; unrelated paths stay restricted.
prevent: Preserve ownership during deployment; avoid chmod 777.

title: Linux: Port occupied
evidence: new service: Address already in use; ss shows an old worker on port 8080
cause: The previous worker was not stopped before starting its replacement.
checks: ss -ltnp; systemctl status orders; ps -fp PID
fix: Identify the owning service; stop the obsolete instance through its supervisor.
verify: Exactly one intended listener exists and the health endpoint responds.
prevent: Use one supervisor and an explicit deployment handover.

title: Linux: Cron environment
evidence: manual backup succeeds; cron mail: aws: not found; cron PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
cause: The job depends on an interactive-shell PATH.
checks: crontab -l; command -v aws; inspect cron mail and environment
fix: Set an explicit PATH or executable path and required nonsecret environment settings.
verify: Run with a minimal environment, then confirm the next scheduled backup.
prevent: Test scheduled jobs outside interactive shells.

title: SSH: Cannot connect
evidence: ssh times out; instance running; security group permits TCP 22 only from an old IP
cause: The current client address is outside the SSH allow rule.
checks: ssh -vvv; inspect instance address, route, and security group source
fix: Update the approved narrow source rule or use the established private access path.
verify: The authorized client connects; unrelated sources remain blocked.
prevent: Prefer managed access and document changing client addresses.

title: DNS: IP works, hostname fails
evidence: curl by IP succeeds; dig app.example.test returns NXDOMAIN
cause: The application hostname has no DNS record.
checks: dig app.example.test; dig @authoritative-server app.example.test
fix: Create or restore the correct record in the authoritative zone.
verify: Authoritative and recursive queries resolve; HTTP succeeds with the hostname.
prevent: Validate DNS records before publishing links.

title: Networking: Local only
evidence: curl localhost:8080 succeeds; ss shows 127.0.0.1:8080; remote connections refused
cause: The application listens only on loopback.
checks: ss -ltnp; curl -v http://127.0.0.1:8080; inspect bind settings
fix: Bind to the intended private interface or place the approved reverse proxy in front.
verify: Requests work through the intended entry point without exposing unnecessary ports.
prevent: Make bind addresses explicit in configuration.

title: TLS: Certificate expired
evidence: browser rejects certificate; notAfter is yesterday; renewal timer disabled
cause: Automatic renewal stopped running.
checks: openssl s_client -connect HOST:443 -servername HOST; inspect renewal logs and timers
fix: Renew through the configured issuer and reload the TLS terminator after validating configuration.
verify: A new connection presents a valid chain and correct hostname.
prevent: Monitor expiry and test renewal routinely.

title: Nginx: Bad gateway
evidence: access log 502; error log connect() failed; upstream configured :9000; app listens :8080
cause: The proxy points to the wrong upstream port.
checks: nginx -t; inspect error log; ss -ltnp; curl upstream directly
fix: Correct the upstream port, validate configuration, then reload.
verify: Both direct upstream and proxied requests succeed.
prevent: Smoke-test proxy-to-upstream connectivity during release.

title: Git: Merge conflict
evidence: git status lists both modified: app.conf; main and feature changed the same timeout
cause: Competing edits require a deliberate combined change.
checks: git status; git diff --cc; git show :2:app.conf; git show :3:app.conf
fix: Resolve the intended behavior, remove conflict markers, test, and complete the merge.
verify: Git has no unmerged entries and the combined configuration passes checks.
prevent: Keep changes focused and coordinate shared configuration edits.

title: Git: Private clone fails
evidence: git clone: Authentication failed; credential entry references a revoked token
cause: The automation credential is invalid.
checks: Inspect credential source, token expiry, repository access, and remote URL without printing secrets.
fix: Replace the credential through the approved secret store with minimum repository permissions.
verify: Clone succeeds from the same automation identity.
prevent: Use scoped credentials with rotation and expiry monitoring.

title: Jenkins: Tool missing
evidence: build: mvn: not found; job moved to a fresh agent
cause: The new agent does not contain the configured build tool.
checks: Inspect agent labels, tool configuration, and PATH in the failing stage.
fix: Select the intended agent or provision the pinned toolchain.
verify: The original build completes on a clean agent.
prevent: Version the build environment and validate agent capabilities.

title: Jenkins: Job queued
evidence: queue: waiting for next available executor; required label linux-docker has zero online nodes
cause: No available agent matches the job label.
checks: Inspect queue reason, node labels, executor count, and agent connection logs.
fix: Reconnect the intended agent or correct the label mapping.
verify: A queued build starts on the expected agent.
prevent: Monitor agent availability and capacity.

title: Jenkins: Docker denied
evidence: docker ps: permission denied on /var/run/docker.sock; agent process lacks socket group
cause: The running agent identity lacks approved Docker access.
checks: id; stat /var/run/docker.sock; inspect agent process group membership
fix: Use a dedicated authorized builder; if socket access is approved, update group membership and restart the agent.
verify: Docker access succeeds as the agent identity without changing socket permissions globally.
prevent: Treat Docker socket access as privileged and isolate builders.

title: GitHub Actions: No trigger
evidence: workflow has branches: [master]; commits are pushed to main
cause: The event filter excludes the active branch.
checks: Inspect workflow location, YAML, event, branch filters, and changed paths.
fix: Correct the branch filter and push a qualifying change.
verify: A workflow run is created for the expected event.
prevent: Test event filters when renaming branches.

title: Docker: Immediate exit
evidence: docker ps -a: Exited (1); logs: required variable APP_MODE missing
cause: The container startup requires an omitted environment variable.
checks: docker ps -a; docker logs CONTAINER; docker inspect CONTAINER
fix: Supply the required nonsecret runtime configuration and recreate the container.
verify: Container stays running and returns a successful health response.
prevent: Validate required runtime settings before release.

title: Docker: Published port fails
evidence: docker port: host port maps to container 8080; app listens on container port 80
cause: The published target port is incorrect.
checks: docker port CONTAINER; docker logs CONTAINER; inspect port mappings
fix: Recreate the container with the host port mapped to the actual listener.
verify: A request through the published loopback port returns the expected body.
prevent: Test published ports from outside the container.

title: Docker: Mounted files unreadable
evidence: image has /srv/index.html; bind mount overlays /srv with an empty directory; response 404
cause: A bind mount hides files bundled in the image.
checks: docker inspect CONTAINER; inspect host mount directory and container listing
fix: Mount the intended populated directory or remove the unnecessary mount.
verify: The expected document is visible and served through the published port.
prevent: Validate mount contents and avoid accidental path overlays.

title: Registry: Authentication error
evidence: push denied: authentication required; configured registry differs from login target
cause: The client authenticated against the wrong registry hostname.
checks: Inspect image reference, registry hostname, credential helper, and credential scope.
fix: Authenticate to the exact target using short-lived credentials and minimum permissions.
verify: A push and a pull by the deployment identity succeed.
prevent: Centralize registry identity configuration.

title: Kubernetes: CrashLoopBackOff
evidence: last state ExitCode 1; previous logs: cannot read /config/app.conf; volume absent
cause: The startup command requires a configuration file that is not mounted.
checks: kubectl describe pod POD; kubectl logs POD --previous; inspect command and volumes
fix: Provide the expected configuration mount or correct the startup path.
verify: Restart count stops increasing and the application stays available.
prevent: Validate startup dependencies in an integration environment.

title: Kubernetes: ImagePullBackOff
evidence: events: manifest unknown; image is busybox:does-not-exist-lab
cause: The deployment references a nonexistent image tag.
checks: kubectl describe pod POD; inspect image reference and registry availability
fix: Deploy the approved existing image tag or digest.
verify: The image pulls and the pod becomes ready.
prevent: Promote immutable image references after verifying publication.

title: Kubernetes: Pending pod
evidence: FailedScheduling: Insufficient cpu; pod requests 1000 CPUs
cause: A resource request exceeds every node's allocatable capacity.
checks: kubectl describe pod POD; kubectl describe nodes; inspect resource requests
fix: Set a measured feasible request; add capacity only when the requirement is real.
verify: Pod schedules and retains adequate resources under load.
prevent: Validate requests against available node sizes.

title: Kubernetes: Missing configuration
evidence: CreateContainerConfigError; secret payment-config not found
cause: The Deployment references a Secret that was never provisioned.
checks: kubectl describe pod POD; kubectl get secrets; inspect secretKeyRef names and keys
fix: Provision the intended Secret through the approved secret workflow or fix the reference.
verify: Container starts and receives the expected setting without exposing it in logs.
prevent: Validate required configuration references before rollout.

title: Kubernetes: Service selector mismatch
evidence: Service selector app=checkout; pods labeled app=orders; EndpointSlices have no addresses
cause: The Service selects the wrong labels.
checks: kubectl get svc SERVICE -o yaml; kubectl get pods --show-labels; kubectl get endpointslices
fix: Correct the Service selector to the intended stable application label.
verify: EndpointSlices contain ready pod addresses and an in-cluster request succeeds.
prevent: Test routing as part of deployment verification.

title: AWS EC2: Security group blocks app
evidence: instance listens on :8080; SG allows :80; intended ALB forwards to :8080
cause: The instance security group lacks ingress from the load balancer on the target port.
checks: Inspect listener, target-group port, instance SG, and ALB SG.
fix: Allow the target port from the ALB security group only.
verify: ALB health checks and requests succeed.
prevent: Manage SG rules and target ports together.

title: AWS S3: Access denied
evidence: GetObject denied; role allows ListBucket on bucket ARN but has no object permission
cause: Bucket listing permission does not grant access to objects.
checks: Inspect caller identity, object ARN, role policy, bucket policy, and encryption requirements.
fix: Grant the required object action on the scoped object prefix; preserve explicit restrictions.
verify: The same identity reads the intended object and remains denied outside scope.
prevent: Test permissions using the application's real identity.

title: AWS ALB: Unhealthy target
evidence: health path /health returns 404; application health endpoint is /healthz
cause: The target group checks an incorrect path.
checks: Inspect target health reason, health path, port, and direct application response.
fix: Set the intended health endpoint and keep meaningful success criteria.
verify: Targets become healthy and user traffic succeeds.
prevent: Keep application and infrastructure health definitions aligned.

title: Terraform: Init backend failure
evidence: terraform init: AccessDenied for state object; current role belongs to a different environment
cause: Terraform uses an incorrect backend identity.
checks: Inspect backend configuration, active identity, state location, and access policy.
fix: Use the approved environment identity and backend configuration.
verify: Initialization accesses the intended backend without copying production state locally.
prevent: Separate environment credentials and backend configuration.

title: Ansible: Host unreachable
evidence: UNREACHABLE: Permission denied (publickey); inventory user=root; image expects ubuntu
cause: The inventory specifies the wrong SSH user.
checks: ansible-inventory --host HOST; ssh -vvv; inspect remote_user and key selection
fix: Set the intended user and approved key in inventory or connection settings.
verify: ansible HOST -m ping succeeds and privilege escalation is explicit.
prevent: Test inventory connection settings before running changes.

title: Prometheus: Target down
evidence: up=0; scrape error connection refused; target configured :9091; metrics listen :9100
cause: The scrape target uses the wrong port.
checks: Inspect /targets, scrape error, target configuration, and direct metrics response.
fix: Correct the scrape address and reload validated configuration.
verify: up becomes 1 and expected metrics are collected.
prevent: Add configuration validation and scrape availability alerts.

title: Grafana: No data
evidence: Prometheus contains http_requests_total; dashboard filters job=web; actual label job=orders
cause: The dashboard filters on a stale label.
checks: Check query inspector, time range, data source, and metric labels.
fix: Update the query or dashboard variable to the intended labels.
verify: Panels return data across an appropriate time range.
prevent: Version dashboards with metric-label changes.

title: Linux: Deleted files retain space
evidence: df shows 95%; du accounts for 20%; lsof +L1 lists a deleted 14G log held by worker
cause: A running process still holds an open deleted file.
checks: df -h; du -xhd1 /var; lsof +L1
fix: Rotate properly or gracefully restart the owning process after preserving evidence.
verify: The file descriptor closes, disk space returns, and the service stays healthy.
prevent: Configure application-aware log rotation.

title: Linux: Inodes exhausted
evidence: df -h shows 60% free; df -i shows 100%; cache contains millions of tiny files
cause: The filesystem has exhausted inodes.
checks: df -i; inspect file counts in the specific cache directory
fix: Remove expired cache files in bounded batches under the retention policy.
verify: New file creation succeeds and inode consumption remains stable.
prevent: Bound cache file counts and monitor inode use.

title: Linux: Slow with normal CPU
evidence: CPU 15%; iowait high; iostat shows disk latency spikes during backup
cause: Backup I/O competes with application storage.
checks: vmstat 1; iostat -xz 1; correlate storage metrics and scheduled jobs
fix: Throttle or reschedule the backup and address underlying storage limits.
verify: Application latency and disk wait return to baseline.
prevent: Load-test backup impact and monitor storage latency.

title: Networking: Intermittent connection failure
evidence: requests to one of three backend IPs time out; two backends succeed
cause: One backend subnet has an incorrect route or firewall path.
checks: Resolve all addresses; test each backend; compare routes and flow logs.
fix: Correct the affected path; remove the unhealthy backend from routing during repair.
verify: Repeated tests succeed against every backend.
prevent: Verify connectivity per backend and enforce consistent network configuration.

title: Nginx: Peak-time timeout
evidence: upstream timed out; DB connection wait rises; proxy CPU normal
cause: Backend requests stall waiting for database connections.
checks: Correlate proxy upstream timings, app traces, DB pool metrics, and slow queries.
fix: Relieve the database bottleneck and bound application concurrency; tune timeouts only with evidence.
verify: Representative load completes within the latency objective without growing queues.
prevent: Monitor dependency saturation and apply backpressure.

title: Git: Faulty production commit
evidence: release commit changes TIMEOUT=30 to TIMEOUT=0; failures begin at deployment
cause: A released configuration change removed a required timeout.
checks: git log --oneline; git show COMMIT; compare deployment timestamp and errors
fix: Revert the faulty change through the release process; preserve shared branch history.
verify: The reverted release passes checks and production error rate recovers.
prevent: Test boundary values and keep rollback artifacts available.

title: Jenkins: Agent inconsistency
evidence: agent-a uses Java 17; agent-b Java 11; build requires Java 17
cause: Agents have different toolchains.
checks: Compare java -version, environment, agent image, and dependency cache.
fix: Pin the required toolchain and route builds to the compatible environment.
verify: A clean build passes on every eligible agent.
prevent: Use versioned agent images and reproducible builds.

title: Jenkins: Upgrade regression
evidence: agent connection fails after controller upgrade; logs report unsupported Java runtime
cause: The agent runtime is incompatible with the upgraded controller requirements.
checks: Inspect controller and agent versions, startup errors, and supported upgrade path.
fix: Upgrade the agent runtime using the supported path or restore the tested controller version.
verify: Agents reconnect and a representative pipeline succeeds.
prevent: Rehearse upgrades with compatibility checks and backups.

title: GitHub Actions: AWS federation denied
evidence: AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity denied; token sub refers to feature branch; trust allows main only
cause: The OIDC subject does not match the IAM trust policy.
checks: Compare workflow permissions, issuer, audience, branch or environment subject, and role trust.
fix: Use the approved protected branch or environment; narrow any required trust-policy change.
verify: Only intended workflow subjects assume the role and complete the scoped AWS action.
prevent: Test OIDC trust conditions; avoid broad wildcard subjects.

title: GitLab CI: Runner mismatch
evidence: pending job tags=[docker,prod]; online runner tags=[docker,linux]
cause: No available runner satisfies all job tags.
checks: Inspect job tags, runner tags, protection, and runner status.
fix: Assign the correct approved runner or correct the job tags.
verify: The job executes on the intended isolated runner.
prevent: Document runner capabilities and protected workload routing.

title: Azure DevOps: Service connection denied
evidence: deployment reports AuthorizationFailed for resource-group write; service principal has Reader
cause: The service connection identity lacks the required deployment role.
checks: Inspect connection identity, subscription scope, role assignment, and failed action.
fix: Grant the minimum appropriate role at the required scope through the approval process.
verify: The deployment succeeds and unrelated scopes remain inaccessible.
prevent: Version and review deployment identity permissions.

title: CI/CD: Wrong artifact deployed
evidence: build publishes commit abc; deployment uses mutable latest currently pointing to def
cause: A mutable tag allowed artifact selection to drift.
checks: Compare build SHA, image digest, deployment manifest, and registry metadata.
fix: Deploy the intended immutable digest and record it in release metadata.
verify: Running image digest matches the validated build.
prevent: Promote the same immutable artifact through environments.

title: CI/CD: Partial deployment
evidence: API version v2 active; worker still v1; worker deploy stage failed
cause: A multi-component release stopped after updating only some components.
checks: Inspect stage logs, release manifest, component versions, and compatibility.
fix: Restore a known compatible version set or complete the approved compatible rollout.
verify: Every component matches the release manifest and end-to-end requests succeed.
prevent: Use compatibility checks and explicit release recovery steps.

title: Docker: Local works, server fails
evidence: server reports exec format error; image built for arm64; server is amd64
cause: The image architecture does not match the deployment host.
checks: Inspect image platform metadata, build platform, and host architecture.
fix: Build and publish the required architecture or a tested multi-platform image.
verify: The image starts on the actual target architecture.
prevent: Validate platform support in CI before promotion.

title: Docker: Database unreachable
evidence: DB container is healthy; application DB_HOST=localhost; containers are separate
cause: localhost points to the application container rather than its database.
checks: Inspect network membership, DB hostname, DNS resolution, and application logs.
fix: Use the database service name on the shared application network.
verify: The application completes a real database query.
prevent: Test service discovery within the deployment network.

title: Kubernetes: OOMKilled
evidence: last state OOMKilled; limit 32Mi; startup allocation exceeds 64Mi
cause: The container's memory limit is below its startup requirement.
checks: kubectl describe pod POD; kubectl logs POD --previous; inspect memory metrics and limits
fix: Set a measured sufficient limit and investigate abnormal growth rather than increasing indefinitely.
verify: The container survives startup and representative load without additional OOM kills.
prevent: Profile memory and validate limits under load.

title: Kubernetes: Readiness failure
evidence: container serves /; readiness requests /ready; response 404
cause: The readiness probe checks a nonexistent endpoint.
checks: Inspect probe configuration, pod events, and direct endpoint responses.
fix: Use a meaningful implemented readiness endpoint with suitable timing.
verify: Pods become ready and the Service successfully routes requests.
prevent: Test probe semantics with the application release.

title: Kubernetes: Liveness restarts
evidence: startup requires 60s; liveness starts at 5s and exhausts its failure threshold
cause: Liveness kills the application before initialization completes.
checks: Compare startup logs, probe timing, restart timestamps, and pod events.
fix: Use an appropriate startup probe and retain a meaningful liveness check.
verify: The pod completes startup and no longer restarts during normal initialization.
prevent: Measure startup time and test probes on cold starts.

title: Kubernetes: Ingress routing failure
evidence: Ingress backend port 8080; Service exposes port 80; pods ready
cause: The Ingress references the wrong Service port.
checks: Inspect ingress description, controller logs, Service ports, and direct Service access.
fix: Reference the Service's exposed port and validate routing configuration.
verify: A request with the correct host and path succeeds through the controller.
prevent: Integration-test ingress, Service, and pod ports together.

title: Kubernetes: Internal DNS failure
evidence: CoreDNS healthy; affected pod uses dnsPolicy Default and inherits unsuitable host DNS
cause: The pod bypasses cluster DNS configuration.
checks: Inspect pod dnsPolicy, /etc/resolv.conf, DNS lookup results, and CoreDNS logs.
fix: Use the appropriate cluster DNS policy for the workload.
verify: The pod resolves the intended Service and connects to it.
prevent: Validate pod DNS settings in deployment review.

title: Kubernetes: NetworkPolicy blocked traffic
evidence: server ready; client connects before policy; ingress policy allows a different client label
cause: The permitted source selector excludes the intended caller.
checks: Inspect policies, namespace and pod labels, ports, and CNI policy support.
fix: Allow the intended client selector and required port while retaining isolation.
verify: Approved client connects; an unapproved client remains blocked.
prevent: Test both allowed and denied network paths.

title: Kubernetes: PVC pending
evidence: PVC requests storageClass fast-ssd; no StorageClass with that name exists
cause: The requested storage class is unavailable.
checks: kubectl describe pvc CLAIM; kubectl get storageclass; inspect provisioner events
fix: Select an available suitable class or install the approved provisioner in the lab.
verify: The claim binds and the workload can read and write its mounted volume.
prevent: Validate storage classes and provisioning before rollout.

title: Kubernetes: Stalled rollout
evidence: new ReplicaSet image unavailable; old replicas serve traffic; rollout deadline exceeded
cause: An invalid image prevents the new ReplicaSet from becoming ready.
checks: kubectl rollout status deployment/APP; inspect ReplicaSets, pod events, and rollout history
fix: Restore the approved previous image or deploy a validated replacement.
verify: Rollout completes and all serving replicas use the intended image.
prevent: Verify artifact existence and rehearse rollbacks.

title: Kubernetes: Node NotReady
evidence: node Ready=False; kubelet logs show disk pressure and runtime errors
cause: Node storage exhaustion disrupted kubelet and container runtime.
checks: Inspect node conditions, kubelet logs, disk usage, and affected workloads.
fix: Cordon the node, preserve service availability, reclaim safe space or replace the node.
verify: Node health recovers or workloads run on healthy replacement capacity.
prevent: Monitor node storage and configure image garbage collection.

title: Kubernetes: HPA not scaling
evidence: HPA shows CPU utilization unknown; containers have no CPU requests
cause: Utilization-based HPA cannot calculate its target without resource requests.
checks: Inspect HPA conditions, metrics API, container requests, and current CPU metrics.
fix: Set measured CPU requests and confirm metrics availability.
verify: HPA computes utilization and scales under a bounded load test.
prevent: Validate autoscaling prerequisites with each workload.

title: Helm: Invalid upgrade values
evidence: helm template fails: wrong type for service.port; value supplied as a mapping
cause: Values do not match the chart's expected structure.
checks: helm lint CHART; helm template RELEASE CHART -f values.yaml; inspect values schema
fix: Correct the value type and validate rendered resources before upgrading.
verify: Rendering succeeds and the upgraded release becomes healthy.
prevent: Maintain a values schema and run chart validation in CI.

title: Argo CD: Sync failure
evidence: application OutOfSync; sync error namespace orders not found
cause: The destination namespace has not been provisioned.
checks: Inspect application destination, sync result, namespace existence, and project permissions.
fix: Create the approved namespace or enable the appropriate managed namespace workflow.
verify: Sync succeeds and application health is verified.
prevent: Declare deployment prerequisites and ordering explicitly.

title: Terraform: State locked
evidence: Error acquiring state lock; lock belongs to a running deployment
cause: Another active Terraform process owns the state.
checks: Inspect lock owner, CI runs, backend details, and active apply status.
fix: Wait for or safely stop the owning operation; unlock only after proving the lock is stale.
verify: One writer acquires the lock and the plan completes.
prevent: Serialize applies per state; never blindly force-unlock.

title: Terraform: Infrastructure drift
evidence: plan proposes reverting an SG rule; CloudTrail shows a manual emergency edit
cause: The actual resource differs from its declared configuration.
checks: terraform plan; inspect configuration diff and audited resource changes
fix: Decide whether to codify the approved change or restore the declared state through review.
verify: A fresh reviewed plan shows only intended changes.
prevent: Manage emergency changes with reconciliation and audit.

title: Ansible: Non-idempotent playbook
evidence: every run reports changed and restarts nginx; task uses shell to rewrite identical config
cause: A shell task reports changes without checking actual state.
checks: Run a second playbook pass; inspect changed tasks and handler triggers.
fix: Use an idempotent template or module and notify handlers only on real change.
verify: A second unchanged run reports no changes and performs no restart.
prevent: Require idempotency checks for configuration playbooks.

title: AWS VPC: Private subnet egress fails
evidence: private route table lacks default route to NAT; NAT exists in public subnet
cause: The private subnet has no intended outbound path.
checks: Inspect subnet association, routes, NAT status, public-subnet IGW route, and NACLs.
fix: Restore the approved egress route or use required service endpoints where suitable.
verify: Required outbound destinations work while unsolicited inbound access stays blocked.
prevent: Test subnet routing and consider ongoing NAT costs before provisioning.

title: AWS RDS: Connections exhausted
evidence: database connection count at limit; application replicas each hold oversized pools
cause: Aggregate application pools exceed database connection capacity.
checks: Inspect DB connections, application replica count, pool limits, and query duration.
fix: Bound pools, remove leaks, and reduce concurrency; scale only when justified.
verify: Connection waits fall and requests succeed under representative load.
prevent: Budget connections across replicas and alert on saturation.

title: AWS Secrets Manager: Rotation failure
evidence: database accepts new password; application still uses cached old secret
cause: The application does not refresh rotated credentials.
checks: Inspect rotation status, secret version stages, application cache behavior, and auth errors.
fix: Refresh credentials using the application's supported mechanism and repair rotation integration.
verify: New connections authenticate after rotation without exposing credentials.
prevent: Exercise rotation end to end and define cache refresh behavior.

title: CI/CD: Concurrent deployments
evidence: release A starts first; release B completes; delayed A then overwrites B
cause: Deployments are not serialized or protected against stale promotion.
checks: Compare deployment timestamps, commit SHAs, environment locks, and stage logs.
fix: Serialize environment changes and reject stale releases; restore the intended artifact.
verify: A concurrency test leaves the newest approved release active.
prevent: Use environment concurrency controls and immutable release metadata.

title: CI/CD: Schema rollback incompatible
evidence: v2 drops customer_name; rolled-back v1 queries customer_name and fails
cause: A destructive migration removed compatibility with the previous application.
checks: Inspect migration history, schema diff, app errors, and supported version matrix.
fix: Choose a tested forward fix or compatible schema recovery; protect data before changes.
verify: Both required application paths and data integrity checks succeed.
prevent: Use expand-contract migrations and rehearse recovery.

title: Deployment: Rolling update downtime
evidence: two replicas; maxUnavailable=100%; old pods removed before new pods are ready
cause: The rollout permits all serving capacity to disappear.
checks: Inspect rollout strategy, readiness, replica availability, and termination timing.
fix: Choose availability-preserving surge and unavailable settings with sufficient capacity.
verify: Continuous traffic succeeds through a fresh rollout.
prevent: Test rollout behavior under traffic and capacity constraints.

title: Deployment: Canary errors
evidence: canary receives 5% traffic; errors occur only for legacy account records
cause: The canary release is incompatible with a subset of production data.
checks: Compare metrics by version and cohort; inspect traces and representative records.
fix: Stop promotion, route traffic away from the canary, and fix compatibility.
verify: Affected cohorts succeed and canary-specific error metrics recover.
prevent: Use representative data and explicit canary abort criteria.

title: Deployment: Blue-green session failure
evidence: after switching to green, users lose carts; sessions stored in blue process memory
cause: Session state is tied to the old application instances.
checks: Compare cookie handling, session storage, backend routing, and drain behavior.
fix: Use compatible shared session storage or the tested session-preserving migration approach.
verify: Existing sessions survive the switch and rollback test.
prevent: Design session compatibility and connection draining before cutover.

title: Security: Exposed AWS credentials
evidence: a real access key appears in a public commit; suspicious API calls follow
cause: A credential was committed and must be treated as compromised.
checks: Identify the key owner and exposure window; inspect CloudTrail without printing credentials.
fix: Immediately revoke or disable the exposed credential, replace dependent access, investigate usage, then clean history appropriately.
verify: The old key fails; intended workloads use new scoped access; suspicious activity is assessed.
prevent: Use workload identities, secret scanning, and pre-commit detection.

title: DevSecOps: Critical vulnerability
evidence: scanner finds a fixable critical package in the runtime image; release gate fails
cause: The promoted image includes a vulnerable dependency.
checks: Inspect affected package, fixed version, runtime exposure, and scanner evidence.
fix: Upgrade or rebuild the dependency and retest; use only a documented approved exception if warranted.
verify: Rescan the exact release digest and run application regression checks.
prevent: Scan immutable artifacts and track remediation deadlines.

title: SonarQube: Hotfix gate fails
evidence: quality gate fails on new code coverage; hotfix adds an untested failure branch
cause: The hotfix does not meet the configured quality criteria.
checks: Inspect the exact failing gate condition, new-code diff, and test report import.
fix: Add meaningful regression coverage or correct report integration; follow explicit emergency policy if necessary.
verify: The relevant regression test and quality gate pass for the hotfix commit.
prevent: Prepare an auditable emergency release process.

title: Kubernetes: Autoscaler cannot expand
evidence: pods Pending; autoscaler event: maximum node group size reached
cause: The node group has reached its configured scaling ceiling.
checks: Inspect autoscaler events, group limits, quotas, pending requests, and subnet addresses.
fix: Adjust approved capacity limits or reduce unnecessary demand after checking quota and cost.
verify: A suitable node joins and pending workloads schedule.
prevent: Capacity-plan autoscaling bounds and alert before exhaustion.

title: Kubernetes: Drain blocked
evidence: kubectl drain waits; PDB minAvailable=2; only two replicas are ready
cause: Eviction would violate the workload's disruption budget.
checks: Inspect PDB allowed disruptions, ready replicas, rollout health, and drain events.
fix: Restore or add healthy replicas, then retry the drain; change the budget only with an availability review.
verify: Drain completes without losing the required healthy capacity.
prevent: Align maintenance capacity, replica count, and disruption budgets.

title: Kubernetes: Volume attach conflict
evidence: new pod scheduled in zone-b; existing volume restricted to zone-a
cause: The volume topology is incompatible with the replacement node.
checks: Inspect PVC, PV node affinity, CSI events, node zones, and workload scheduling.
fix: Schedule compatible capacity or perform a supported data-preserving storage migration.
verify: Volume attaches and existing data is readable and writable.
prevent: Plan storage topology and test rescheduling behavior.

title: Kubernetes: Removed API after upgrade
evidence: deployment automation fails: no matches for kind Ingress in extensions/v1beta1
cause: Manifests use an API removed from the upgraded cluster.
checks: Inspect cluster version, discovery, manifests, and API deprecation reports.
fix: Migrate manifests and required fields to a supported API; validate against the target version.
verify: Resources apply and routing works on the upgraded cluster.
prevent: Scan deprecated APIs and rehearse upgrades in advance.

title: Kubernetes: Quota blocks recovery
evidence: new pod rejected: exceeded quota requests.cpu; namespace already at its limit
cause: Recovery needs capacity that the namespace quota disallows.
checks: Inspect ResourceQuota usage, pod requests, failed events, and obsolete workloads.
fix: Remove genuinely obsolete allocations or approve appropriate quota with underlying capacity available.
verify: Recovery pods are admitted and service availability returns.
prevent: Reserve recovery headroom and monitor quota consumption.

title: Kubernetes: Healthy pods, intermittent failure
evidence: one Service endpoint uses the old port; failures correlate with one ReplicaSet
cause: Mixed pod versions expose incompatible serving ports during rollout.
checks: Compare EndpointSlices, pod versions, named ports, and per-endpoint requests.
fix: Restore compatible serving configuration and remove the faulty version through a controlled rollout.
verify: Every endpoint responds and repeated Service requests succeed.
prevent: Keep stable port contracts across rolling releases.

title: Argo CD: Emergency fix reverted
evidence: manual replica change disappears; application has automated self-heal enabled
cause: Git remains authoritative and self-healing restores its declared state.
checks: Inspect application sync policy, Git desired state, audit events, and timeline.
fix: Commit the approved fix to Git; use an explicit temporary reconciliation pause only when required.
verify: The fix persists after reconciliation and application health recovers.
prevent: Document emergency GitOps procedures and reconcile temporary changes.

title: Terraform: Database replacement proposed
evidence: plan marks database -/+ because identifier changes; production data exists
cause: A configuration change modifies a replacement-triggering property.
checks: Inspect the full saved plan, resource schema behavior, state address, and intended rename.
fix: Stop the apply; preserve the existing database and choose a reviewed non-destructive migration or configuration correction.
verify: A fresh reviewed plan contains no unintended replacement.
prevent: Review destructive plans and protect critical resources with layered controls.

title: Terraform: Partial apply inconsistent
evidence: network created; database failed; backend has some new resource entries
cause: An apply completed only part of the desired graph.
checks: Inspect apply logs, current state, actual cloud resources, and a fresh plan.
fix: Reconcile observed resources through supported import or configuration fixes; never blindly edit state JSON.
verify: A reviewed follow-up apply converges and the final plan has no unexpected changes.
prevent: Use smaller changes, reliable backends, and recoverable deployment procedures.

title: Terraform: Provider upgrade changes plan
evidence: lock file changed; new provider now proposes resource changes with unchanged configuration
cause: Provider behavior changed during an unreviewed dependency upgrade.
checks: Compare lock files, provider versions, changelog, schema behavior, and plans.
fix: Restore the tested constraint or migrate deliberately and review the resulting plan.
verify: The chosen provider produces the intended plan and passes environment validation.
prevent: Commit the lock file and review provider upgrades separately.

title: AWS EKS: Workload identity denied
evidence: pod receives AccessDenied; service account refers to a role whose trust names another namespace
cause: The workload identity trust does not match the pod's service account.
checks: Inspect service account, identity association or federation setup, role trust, and caller identity.
fix: Correct the intended identity binding and narrowly scoped trust conditions.
verify: The pod assumes the intended role and performs only required actions.
prevent: Test identity from the actual workload after deployment.

title: AWS Auto Scaling: More nodes, still slow
evidence: instance count doubles; DB CPU and lock waits remain saturated
cause: The shared database bottleneck cannot be solved by adding application instances.
checks: Correlate instance metrics, request traces, database waits, and scaling events.
fix: Relieve the database bottleneck and bound incoming concurrency; avoid unbounded instance growth.
verify: Latency improves under load without escalating connection pressure.
prevent: Scale on bottleneck-aware metrics and enforce backpressure.

title: AWS: Availability Zone failure
evidence: all application instances are in zone-a; zone-a becomes unavailable
cause: The application has a single-zone failure domain.
checks: Inspect subnet placement, load balancer targets, dependency topology, and regional health.
fix: Recover using the tested multi-zone or disaster-recovery procedure with healthy dependencies.
verify: Requests succeed with the affected zone unavailable and data checks pass.
prevent: Spread critical tiers across failure domains and rehearse zone loss.

title: AWS RDS: Failover reconnection fails
evidence: RDS endpoint resolves to new address; app pool repeatedly retries the old address
cause: The application retains stale database connections or DNS results.
checks: Inspect failover events, endpoint resolution from the app, pool behavior, and retry logs.
fix: Refresh connections through the supported client mechanism and use bounded backoff with correct DNS handling.
verify: New connections reach the writer and a representative transaction succeeds.
prevent: Exercise failover and configure client reconnection behavior.

title: AWS Route 53: Cutover inconsistent
evidence: authoritative DNS returns new target; some resolvers retain old answer within previous TTL
cause: Cached records from before the cutover have not expired.
checks: Compare authoritative and recursive answers, previous TTL, old endpoint health, and change time.
fix: Keep the old path compatible through cache expiry; repair incorrect authoritative records if present.
verify: Queries and user requests converge after the relevant cache windows.
prevent: Lower TTL ahead of planned cutovers and retain a rollback path.

title: AWS Lambda: Private database timeout
evidence: Lambda subnet SG allows egress; RDS SG does not allow ingress from Lambda SG
cause: The database security group blocks the Lambda execution path.
checks: Inspect function VPC settings, security-group references, DB port, flow logs, and connection timing.
fix: Allow the required database port from the function's security group and confirm subnet reachability.
verify: A bounded invocation completes a real database operation.
prevent: Test the function-to-database path after network changes.

title: Azure AKS: Upgrade stalled
evidence: node surge cannot allocate VMs; regional vCPU quota is exhausted
cause: Upgrade surge needs additional capacity that quota does not permit.
checks: Inspect upgrade events, VM quota, subnet capacity, surge settings, and disruption budgets.
fix: Secure approved capacity or use a supported maintenance strategy preserving availability.
verify: Upgrade progresses and workloads remain healthy.
prevent: Preflight quota, addresses, and disruption constraints before upgrades.

title: Azure ACR: Image pulls denied
evidence: AKS image pulls fail after kubelet identity replacement; role remains on old identity
cause: The active kubelet identity lacks registry pull access.
checks: Inspect kubelet identity, registry scope, role assignments, and image-pull events.
fix: Assign the appropriate scoped pull permission for the registry's configured authorization mode.
verify: A new pod pulls the intended image using the active cluster identity.
prevent: Validate registry integration after identity changes.

title: Azure Key Vault: Secret access lost
evidence: application identity is valid; secret read denied after vault access model changed
cause: The new authorization model lacks an equivalent assignment for the application.
checks: Inspect vault authorization mode, active managed identity, role or policy scope, and audit logs.
fix: Restore narrowly scoped secret access using the vault's active authorization model.
verify: The application retrieves its required secret while unrelated identities stay denied.
prevent: Review identity permissions when migrating access models.

title: GCP GKE: Cloud access denied
evidence: pod starts; Cloud Storage returns 403; workload identity binding points to another service account
cause: The pod's Kubernetes identity is not authorized as intended.
checks: Inspect workload identity configuration, service-account bindings, active principal, and resource policy.
fix: Correct the intended workload identity binding and scoped resource access.
verify: The workload accesses its required resource without a downloaded service-account key.
prevent: Validate identity bindings and resource IAM together.

title: GCP Cloud Build: Publish denied
evidence: build passes; Artifact Registry upload denied for the build's actual service account
cause: The build identity lacks write access to the target repository.
checks: Inspect the build's service account, repository location, image path, and IAM denial.
fix: Grant only the required repository write permission to the actual build identity.
verify: The same build publishes its artifact and downstream deployment can pull it.
prevent: Declare build identities and repository permissions explicitly.

title: Monitoring: Alert never delivered
evidence: Prometheus alert firing; Alertmanager route sends it to an unused receiver
cause: Alert routing configuration directs the alert away from the on-call receiver.
checks: Inspect firing state, labels, routing tree, silences, inhibition, and delivery logs.
fix: Correct the intended route and receiver configuration; test an end-to-end notification.
verify: The correct receiver gets firing and resolved test notifications.
prevent: Run periodic end-to-end alert-delivery tests.

title: ELK / Loki: Logs disappear
evidence: collector reports buffer full; backend returns rate-limit errors; application logs continue locally
cause: The ingestion backend is throttling and collector buffers are exhausted.
checks: Inspect collector errors, queue size, backend availability, rate limits, and source timestamps.
fix: Restore ingestion capacity, reduce unnecessary volume, and recover buffered logs where possible.
verify: A new identifiable event reaches search and ingestion lag returns to normal.
prevent: Monitor ingestion lag and bound noisy log sources.

title: Incident response: Shared dependency failure
evidence: API, workers, and login fail simultaneously; all traces stall on the same DNS resolver
cause: A shared DNS dependency causes failures across otherwise healthy services.
checks: Build a dependency timeline; compare healthy and failing paths; test resolution from each tier.
fix: Restore the shared resolver or activate the tested alternative; avoid unrelated restarts.
verify: Critical user journeys recover across all affected services.
prevent: Map shared dependencies and rehearse their failure modes.

title: Disaster recovery: Restore misses target
evidence: backup jobs report success; restore fails because the encryption key is unavailable in recovery
cause: Backup creation was tested but recovery dependencies were not.
checks: Inspect restore errors, backup integrity, key access, recovery identity, and measured elapsed time.
fix: Restore required key access through approved recovery controls, then repeat a complete isolated restore.
verify: Application and data checks pass; measured recovery time and data loss meet stated objectives.
prevent: Run scheduled restore drills including identity, keys, networking, and application startup.
